unit.why: A single narrative: a poor hasid disobeys R. Uri of Strelisk's lottery advice, the rebbe grows angry and withdraws, and the young R. Simha Bunem pacifies him with a homily.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי בשם הרב הקדוש ר׳ מורי מסטרעלצק
stories.summary_en: R. Uri of Strelisk tells a poor hasid to buy a lottery ticket with a given number to marry off his daughter; the hasid loses heart and sells the ticket, which then wins for another man; the angry rebbe refuses to see anyone until the young R. Simha Bunem explains that a tzaddik may decree wealth but may not dictate to God the means, after which the rebbe gives the poor man a general blessing.
